classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the southeast bearing as 20 degrees east of south, then select the appropriate trigonometric ratios for the two requested components.

content.prompt: A ship leaves port and sails on a bearing of $160^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$ for $200\text{ km}$. Find, correct to the nearest tenth of a kilometre:

children.label: a
children.prompt: how far south the ship is from the port

answer.worked:
The course is $180^{\circ}-160^{\circ}=20^{\circ}$ east of south. The southward distance is adjacent to this angle.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Distance south}&=200\cos20^{\circ}\\\text{Distance south}&\approx187.9\text{ km}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: how far east the ship is from the port

answer.worked:
The eastward distance is opposite the $20^{\circ}$ angle east of south.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Distance east}&=200\sin20^{\circ}\\\text{Distance east}&\approx68.4\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
